description: The Ferrari F8 Tributo is revealed inside a dark red chamber as silky red cloth flows across the air and wraps around the invisible shape of a car. The fabric disintegrates mid-air, revealing the polished Ferrari underneath, surrounded by floating spotlight drones that activate as the logo appears.
camera: slow dolly-ins, sweeping camera from low angles, dramatic zoom on curves
lighting: deep red and gold accents, focused spotlights, soft floor reflections
location: dimly lit red reveal chamber with glossy black floor
atmosphere: suspenseful, luxurious, silk particles in air
elements: floating silk fabric wrapping invisible car silhouette
particles dispersing to reveal shiny Ferrari body
motion: fabric flows and forms over car, vanishes to reveal full Ferrari
cta_motion: Ferrari logo emerges in soft gold shimmer above the hood
ending: F8 Tributo displayed center-stage with moving light accents and full-body reveal
